mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prescription (user_id, drug_id, image_url, ai_result, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{drugId}, #{imageUrl}, #{aiResult}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, drug_id AS drugId, image_url AS imageUrl, ai_result AS aiResult, status, review_comment AS reviewComment, reviewer_id AS reviewerId, created_at AS createdAt, reviewed_at AS reviewedAt FROM prescription WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, p.drug_id AS drugId, d.name AS drugName, p.status, p.review_comment AS reviewComment, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt FROM prescription p LEFT JOIN drug d ON d.id = p.drug_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, u.phone AS userPhone, p.drug_id AS drugId, d.name AS drugName, p.image_url AS imageUrl, p.status, p.review_comment AS reviewComment, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM prescription p LEFT JOIN drug d ON d.id = p.drug_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.status = 0 ORDER BY p.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE prescription SET status = #{status}, review_comment = #{comment}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
